contactHealth.blockedHelp: {count} records are blocked. They may still be in flight or have an unknown result. Wait or reconcile with the provider before any resend.
contactHealth.help.configuration_invalid: Check required fields, region, templates, sender identity, provider selection and implemented consumers.
contactHealth.help.credentials_missing: Check INTEGRATION_CONFIG_KEY and referenced deployment variables. Do not arbitrarily replace the root key used for stored ciphertext.
contactHealth.help.credentials_unreadabl: Confirm the root key is present and matches the original key, then check the encrypted configuration. Replacing a key does not recover old ciphertext.
contactHealth.help.database_error: Use SQLState and the error code to check schema, permissions and database state. Do not post database passwords in chat.
contactHealth.help.database_unavailable: Check the database service, network, target database and account permissions. Keep credentials in deployment settings.
contactHealth.help.degraded: At least one channel or recent dispatch needs investigation.
contactHealth.help.disabled: This component or legacy channel is disabled. Other channels may still need configuration.
contactHealth.help.dispatch_failed: A provider rejection or input validation failure was recorded. Correct the cause first; this panel has no resend action.
contactHealth.help.dispatch_unconfirmed: The original attempt remains blocked and is not replayed automatically. Check provider results and billing before proceeding.
contactHealth.help.idle: Configure a contracted channel and required fields before verifying reception. This panel does not enable a channel.
contactHealth.help.migration_required: Compare actual metadata with the reviewed incremental migrations using the table and error code. Do not reimport the full schema into an existing database.
contactHealth.help.not_checked: There is no scheduled result yet. Refreshing configuration diagnostics does not dispatch messages.
contactHealth.help.paused: Check LIVE mode, feature switches, channel enablement and provider selection. Pauses are never bypassed.
contactHealth.help.ready: This only means configuration is available or a queue poll completed. It does not verify actual delivery.
contactHealth.help.requires_reconciliati: Wait for in-flight requests and reconcile provider results. Unknown outcomes must not be replayed automatically.
contactHealth.help.unexpected_error: Investigate the safe reason code and server logs. Do not disclose verification codes, recipients or credential values.
contactHealth.invalid: The diagnostic response is incompatible. Check the frontend and backend versions, then retry.
contactHealth.notConfigured: No channel is available for dispatch. Registration and password recovery verification are not yet proven operational.
contactHealth.notDeliveryProof: A successful configuration check or queue poll is not proof of delivery. Verify provider receipts or actual reception separately.
contactHealth.queueEmpty: There are no SMS or email queue records.
contactHealth.queueUnavailable: The queue could not be read. An empty list does not mean there is no pending work.
contactHealth.readOnly: Reads configuration and queue status only. No verification messages or chargeable tests are sent.
contactHealth.sessionChanged: The account has changed. Reopen this diagnostic panel.
contactHealth.title: Verification delivery diagnostics
